Careers

Senior work.
Remotely.

Thinklens is a small, senior, India-based team delivering Data, BI, and IT work for clients across the globe. No layers, no ticket queues — you own the problem and talk to the people who have it.

What the job
actually looks like.

We're deliberately small. That shapes everything about how the work feels day to day.

Ownership

You own the outcome

You're not handed a ticket and a deadline. You scope the problem with the client, decide the approach, and see it through to sign-off.

Remote

Remote, properly

Remote-first since day one — not a policy bolted onto an office culture. Work from anywhere in India, with overlap hours that suit the account.

Range

Variety, not repetition

Different clients, industries, and data estates. You'll go deeper in your specialism and broader across the stack than a single-product role allows.

Seniority

Senior people only

Every consultant here has shipped real work. You'll be reviewed by people who understand what you built and can make it better.

hiring.
